d: Range Rover Electric review: we drive the first fully electric Range Rover in Scotland to find out if JLR’s new EV still feels like a Range Rover. On first impression, you’d be hard pressed to tell the Range Rover Electric apart from the petrol and diesel versions. The only real giveaways are a new aero-optimised grille and EV-specific alloy wheels, while the cabin carries over almost untouched, right down to the gear selector and the 13.1-inch Pivi Pro touchscreen.
